summary: Iteration 3 verified 4 new features: (1) Import Excel in /admin/input, (2) Year-over-year delta on Dashboard & IndicatorDetail trend chart, (3) /peta Kelurahan tile map, (4) /admin/users Kelola Admin. Backend: added 17 new pytest tests (TestLuarKotaRegression x2, TestAdmins x11, TestChangePassword x2 plus an inlined duplicate email case) covering admins CRUD & auth guards, LUAR KOTA regression. Full backend suite = 50/50 passed. Frontend (Playwright on preview URL): /peta shows nav-peta, peta-title, peta-total, peta-top5, peta-map-download-png, all 7 kecamatan containers, tiles, and peta-indicator-select switches reload. Dashboard year=2026 shows 2 kelurahan KPI cards (TC/Penemuan RO) each with indicator-card-{id}-delta containing 'vs 2025' (e.g. '+5 vs 2025'). IndicatorDetail /indikator/treatment_coverage shows stat-delta ('+5 dari 0') and chart legend contains both 'Kumulatif 2025' and 'Kumulatif 2026'. /admin/input: btn-download-template & btn-import-excel visible; set_input_files on import-excel-input with an openpyxl-generated xlsx (header Faskes,Target Angka,Target %,Jan..Des; row PUSKESMAS BAROS,120,100,5,6,7,0..) populated the grid (target=120, Jan=5), save succeeded, then values reset to zero for cleanup. /admin/users: add-admin-form added qa.test@example.com with status Aktif; owner row has 'Utama' badge and NO toggle/delete buttons; toggled created admin → Nonaktif; deleted via admin-delete + admin-delete-confirm; change-password-form with wrong old password showed 'Password lama salah' toast. Owner password preserved.

minor.issue: CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True still present (same as iter 1&2). Non-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: Admin endpoints correctly protect owner (ADMIN_EMAIL) from toggle/delete and prevent self-delete/self-deactivate (server.py lines 265-278).
AdminIn uses min_length=8 for password → FastAPI returns 422 (not 400) for short password. Request said '422 if shorter' and it matches.
Create admin lowercases email (line 251) and rejects duplicates (400). Good.
/api/auth/password requires current_admin and verifies old password with bcrypt. Clean.
list_admins uses admin_out() which strips _id and adds is_owner flag. No ObjectId leak.
PetaKelurahan.jsx correctly groups 33 kelurahan into 7 kecamatan via KECAMATAN config and filters out luar_kota from tiles. heatColor based on capaian_angka/max.
Dashboard fetches current-year + previous-year summary and passes `prev` row to KpiCard; Delta renders both for noTarget (angka diff) and target (percent-point diff).
IndicatorDetail Trend chart adds 'Kumulatif {year-1}' Line in grey (#94A3B8) and current year highlighted — legend renders both as verified.
importExcel.js parses header against MONTHS_SHORT + 'Target Angka'/'Target %'; works with openpyxl-generated xlsx.
